points.label: Composer Context exact icon rasters
points.narrative: The branch icon still used stale Lucide path data and had no #818181 raster at any selectable size, causing Icon to fall back to an 18px white PNG and downscale it to 12px. Syncing GitBranch to Lucide 0.564, generating exact 12px dark/light Context variants, and preferring exact-size assets raises branch-icon SSIM from 0.684822 to 0.974066. Hero Context SSIM rises from 0.980469 to 0.983169 and Sendable Context SSIM rises from 0.980288 to 0.982988 without geometry changes. A fresh exact-bundle Native run verifies four 12px icons, preserved controls/labels, main transport advancement, and zero renderer errors. A matched light Hero diagnostic also passes and confirms muted rather than white fallback; its broader Context material remains a separately registered scope and does not overwrite whole-state light evidence.

attribution.reason: Matched dark Hero and Sendable snapshots isolate the exact-raster product change; source-contract tests prevent stale path/fallback regression, and exact-bundle Native plus matched light diagnostic evidence cover both rendering targets.

points.label: Composer light Context shared material
points.narrative: The newly validated light Hero scope matched snapshot, state, theme, and viewport, then localized 64% of Context absolute error to the top material ramp. Web authority showed a 221-to-254 glass-shadow profile while Lynx used five near-white bands. A CSS gradient improved Browser Preview but rendered flat on Native, so it was classified as a cross-surface product gap and superseded. The final shared 16-band view ramp renders the same pixel profile in Lynx-for-Web and Native, raises light Context SSIM from 0.847811 to 0.913372, raises the matched Composer-region SSIM from 0.908741 to 0.924627, and reduces Context absolute error by 69.4%. Dark Web/Lynx frames remain byte-identical. Exact-theme Native verification proves all 16 bands, endpoint colors, a retained 2560x1640 frame, main transport advancement, and zero renderer errors; Native whole-state pixel parity is not claimed because its canonical fixture differs.

attribution.reason: Matched light Browser evidence supplies the whole-Composer residual; dark byte identity rules out regression, while exact-theme Native DOM and pixel evidence prove the shared ramp rather than the rejected Browser-only gradient.

points.label: Composer Hero 1440 responsive certification
points.narrative: Fresh matched 1440x900 dark and light Browser cells preserve the same 768px Composer and 724px Context geometry as 1280, shifted exactly +80px horizontally and +40px vertically; their residuals match the existing 1280 states to rounding, so no score is double-counted. Native cold start exposed a real reconciliation defect: late model-option insertion could reuse the runtime wrapper's unkeyed sibling position and overlap controls. Stable top-level toolbar keys fix the root cause. Two dark cold starts pass, a deterministic High · 1M fixture renders all five controls in canonical order, and light Native passes with the shared 16-band Context ramp. All exact-bundle runs advance main transport, retain 2880x1800 evidence, report zero renderer errors, and dispose isolated state.

attribution.reason: Matched Browser viewports prove no responsive pixel regression, while repeated and forced-option Native cold starts directly cover the keyed reconciliation fix without changing ledger weights or duplicating existing material residuals.

points.label: Composer Footer icon material
points.narrative: After Footer geometry and label alpha matched, localized dark Hero error showed that runtime and interaction mode icons still used opaque #a1a1aa PNGs while Web composed muted #818181 at 70% element alpha. Exact dark/light rasters plus 0.7 icon and chevron opacity preserve geometry and raise Hero Footer SSIM from 0.853794 to 0.855352 and Sendable Footer SSIM from 0.850723 to 0.852281. Composer-region SSIM improves by 0.000573 in both states. Matched light Hero corroborates the theme mapping. Exact-bundle dark and light Native runs resolve all five Footer icon leaves to opacity 0.7, advance main transport from 2 to 3, report zero renderer errors, retain 2560x1640 frames, and dispose isolated state; they are cross-surface material/readiness evidence, not Native pixel-residual updates.

attribution.reason: Direct matched dark Hero and Sendable before/after pairs isolate the icon-material change with unchanged geometry; light Browser and exact-theme Native independently cover the shared theme mapping and opacity contract.
